_comment: Single source of truth for the dev environment. aosp-academy setup reads this. Bump a version here, re-run setup, and commit the change.

winget.purpose: javac/java for helpers, R8/D8, apktool, jadx, Gradle
mirror and control the phone over ADB

cmdlineTools._note: Per host OS, SHA-1 from Google's repository2-3.xml (the publisher's own checksum).

androidSdk._note: Names use the Android CLI form (slash, not sdkmanager's semicolon). android-37.0 = Android 17, the image's OS. The SDK's platform-tools are for Android Studio; device work uses the pinned copy in work/platform-tools (inputs.platformTools).

jars.name: r8-9.5.33.jar
jars.purpose: D8 used to build stock/helpers (aosp-academy stock build)

archives.name: jadx-1.5.7.zip
archives.purpose: jadx command-line decompiler (the winget package is GUI-only)

archives.name: gradle-9.9.2-bin.zip
archives.purpose: Gradle for aosp-academy new-app (it writes each new project's wrapper, pinned to the same version and checksum)

deviceTools._note: Optional tools for the prepared device (docs/apps/instrumentation.md, docs/device/stock.md). Downloaded into work/device-tools/, git-ignored. Bumping these is routine, unlike the inputs section. buildOnly entries are image-build inputs (the Fossify APKs built into aospacademy_arm64): only the build node downloads them (aosp-academy image inputs); setup skips them.

frida._note: pip pins for work/.venv-frida: frida==version (must match the server above), frida-tools==toolsVersion

gsi._note: Google's AOSP arm64 GSI for Android 17, the stable release of the same drop as the source tag below; booted through DSU by aosp-academy gsi (docs/device/dsu.md) and run on this device on 2026-11-19 (step 0 of the tag move, docs/environment/tag-moves.md). Not fetched by the bootstrap: the download is ~1 GB and behind Google's terms, which the script asks you to accept. Until 2026-11-19 this was the Android 16 GSI BP4A.251205.006 (sha256 2171cf0e...).
gsi.name: aosp_arm64-exp-CP2A.260605.012-15430684-8e545e1e.zip

aosp._note: Source for building the image on a Linux build node (image/build/*.sh, docs/environment/image.md). The tag is the AOSP release of the same Android 17 drop as the pinned GSI binary above (android-17.0.0_r1 is CP2A.260605.016 per source.android.com/docs/setup/reference/build-numbers; the GSI binary is CP2A.260605.012), so what you build matches what was validated. Builds 1 to 9 came from android-16.0.0_r4 (BP4A.251205.006); Android 16 was dropped on 2026-11-19. The lunch target is verified against `lunch` after the first sync. treeDir is where the scripts put the tree (AOSP_DIR overrides it).

wireguardTools._note: Source of the image's /product/bin/wg (wireguard-tools' userspace tool; the kernel has WireGuard built in). AOSP has no wireguard-tools, so aosp-academy image inputs clones this tag and checks the commit, and apply-local.sh copies src/ into device/aospacademy/gsi/wireguard/src for its Android.bp. GPL-2.0-only.

inputs._note: The device procedure's exact tested inputs (docs/device/walkthrough.md, validation.md). Downloaded into work/ ($Work), which is git-ignored. Change these only when deliberately re-validating the procedure.

platformTools._note: The platform-tools every device command uses (work/platform-tools), per host OS, SHA-1 from Google's repository2-3.xml. It matches what the Android SDK installs, so Android Studio's adb server and ours are the same version. 37.0.1 (Windows SHA-1 e03e78b1...) ran the bootloader and Magisk stages on both units in 2026-11; moved to 37.0.3 on 2026-11-19.

motorolaDriver.name: Motorola_Mobile_Drivers_64bit.msi
motorolaDriver._note: No stable direct URL; download manually from the support page. The bootstrap verifies it if present.

appTemplate._comment: aosp-academy new-app: the versions a new app project starts with. The project's own wrapper and build files pin them from then on.
